result.summary: The screen is mostly well-structured, with minor layout and text truncation flaws.

issues.description: The third card title under 'Fastest near you' is cut off ('Trattoria Piccol').
issues.suggestion: Enable text wrapping to two lines or apply standard ellipsis truncation.

issues.description: Category chips and card carousels clip abruptly at the right screen edge without a fade hint.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle gradient fade to signal horizontal scrollability.
